<|user|>Write a Breakout game with three rows of green bricks, a blue paddle controlled with the mouse or arrow keys and a score with a dark background<|end|><|assistant|><!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Breakout</title>
<style>
body {
  margin: 0;
  min-height: 100vh;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  font-family: system-ui, sans-serif;
  background: #111827;
  color: #f9fafb;
}
canvas {
  border-radius: 10px;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c" width="480" height="400"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById("c");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
const W = canvas.width;
const H = canvas.height;
const paddle = { x: W / 2 - 40, w: 80 };
let ball;
let bricks;
let score = 0;
function reset() {
  ball = { x: W / 2, y: H - 60, vx: 3, vy: -3 };
  bricks = [];
  for (let r = 0; r < 3; r++) for (let c = 0; c < 8; c++) bricks.push({ x: 10 + c * 58, y: 40 + r * 24, alive: true, color: "#16a34a" });
  score = 0;
}
canvas.addEventListener("mousemove", (e) => {
  paddle.x = e.offsetX - paddle.w / 2;
});
document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if (e.key === "ArrowLeft") paddle.x -= 30;
  if (e.key === "ArrowRight") paddle.x += 30;
});
function loop() {
  ball.x += ball.vx;
  ball.y += ball.vy;
  if (ball.x < 8 || ball.x > W - 8) ball.vx *= -1;
  if (ball.y < 8) ball.vy *= -1;
  if (ball.y > H - 30 && ball.x > paddle.x && ball.x < paddle.x + paddle.w && ball.vy > 0) ball.vy *= -1;
  if (ball.y > H) reset();
  for (const b of bricks) {
    if (b.alive && ball.x > b.x && ball.x < b.x + 52 && ball.y > b.y && ball.y < b.y + 18) {
      b.alive = false;
      ball.vy *= -1;
      score++;
    }
  }
  if (bricks.every((b) => !b.alive)) reset();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#0b1020";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  for (const b of bricks) {
    if (!b.alive) continue;
    ctx.fillStyle = b.color;
    ctx.fillRect(b.x, b.y, 52, 18);
  }
  ctx.fillStyle = "#2563eb";
  ctx.fillRect(paddle.x, H - 24, paddle.w, 10);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.font = "16px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText("Score: " + score, 10, 22);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
reset();
loop();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<|user|>Design 3 purple balls bouncing around inside a canvas, slow in dark mode.<|end|><|assistant|><!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Bouncing balls</title>
<style>
body {
  margin: 0;
  min-height: 100vh;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  font-family: system-ui, sans-serif;
  background: #111827;
  color: #f9fafb;
}
canvas {
  background: #0b1020;
  border-radius: 8px;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c" width="400" height="300"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById("c");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
const balls = [];
for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
  balls.push({
    x: 40 + Math.random() * 320,
    y: 40 + Math.random() * 220,
    vx: (1.5 + Math.random()) * (Math.random() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1),
    vy: (1.5 + Math.random()) * (Math.random() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1),
    r: 16,
    color: "#9333ea",
  });
}
function loop() {
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
  for (const b of balls) {
    b.x += b.vx;
    b.y += b.vy;
    if (b.x < b.r || b.x > canvas.width - b.r) b.vx *= -1;
    if (b.y < b.r || b.y > canvas.height - b.r) {
      b.vy *= -1;
      b.y = Math.max(b.r, Math.min(canvas.height - b.r, b.y));
    }
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, b.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = b.color;
    ctx.fill();
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
loop();
</script>
</body>
</html>

let bird;
let pipes;
let score;
let frame;
function reset() {
  bird = { y: H / 2, v: 0 };
  pipes = [];
  score = 0;

    ctx.fillRect(p.x, 0, 52, p.top);

    if (!p.passed && p.x + 52 < 80) {
      p.passed = true;
      score++;

  }
  pipes = pipes.filter((p) => p.x > -60);
  if (bird.y > H || bird.y < 0) reset();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#dc2626";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(80, bird.y, 14, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.font = "bold 28px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText(score, W / 2 - 8, 50);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
reset();
loop();
</script>
</body>

  ctx.fillStyle = "#0b1020";

  ctx.fill();
  ctx.font = "16px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText("Score: " + score, 10, 22);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
reset();
loop();
</script>

        return requestAnimationFrame(loop);

  things = things.filter((t) => t.y < H + 50);
  score += 0.1;
  ctx.fillStyle = "#16a34a";

<html lang="en">

<title>Pong</title>
<style>
body {
  margin: 0;
  min-height: 100vh;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  font-family: system-ui, sans-serif;

</style>

<body>
<canvas id="c" width="480" height="320"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById("c");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
const W = canvas.width;
const H = canvas.height;
const player = { y: H / 2 - 30, h: 60 };
const ai = { y: H / 2 - 30, h: 60 };
const ball = { x: W / 2, y: H / 2, vx: 4, vy: 3, r: 8 };
let score = 0;
let up = false;
let down = false;
document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if (e.key === "ArrowUp") up = true;
  if (e.key === "ArrowDown") down = true;
});
document.addEventListener("keyup", (e) => {
  if (e.key === "ArrowUp") up = false;
  if (e.key === "ArrowDown") down = false;
});
function reset() {
  ball.x = W / 2;
  ball.y = H / 2;
  ball.vx = 4 * (Math.random() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1);
  ball.vy = 3;
}
function loop() {
  if (up) player.y -= 5;
  if (down) player.y += 5;
  player.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(H - player.h, player.y));
  ai.y += (ball.y - (ai.y + ai.h / 2)) * 0.06;
  ball.x += ball.vx;
  ball.y += ball.vy;
  if (ball.y < ball.r || ball.y > H - ball.r) ball.vy *= -1;
  if (ball.x < 24 && ball.y > player.y && ball.y < player.y + player.h && ball.vx < 0) {
    ball.vx *= -1.05;
    score++;
  }
  if (ball.x > W - 24 && ball.y > ai.y && ball.y < ai.y + ai.h && ball.vx > 0) ball.vx *= -1;
  if (ball.x < 0) {
    score = 0;
    reset();
  }
  if (ball.x > W) reset();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#0b1020";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#4f46e5";
  ctx.fillRect(10, player.y, 8, player.h);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#9333ea";
  ctx.fillRect(W - 18, ai.y, 8, ai.h);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.font = "20px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText(score, W / 2 - 6, 28);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
loop();
</script>
</body>
